subject.title: fix(zai): send current GLM thinking params

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Z.ai provider-wire change from `enable_thinking` to `thinking.type` plus gated `reasoning_effort` based on current docs, tests, and BigModel live proof?
rationale: The patch appears correct from source, tests, and official docs, but provider payload contracts can affect real Z.ai users if host behavior differs, and the proof threshold for that risk is a maintainer-owned decision.

options.title: Accept Current Contract
options.body: Merge this PR after normal exact-head checks because both builders are aligned and the redacted live GLM-5.2 proof matches the documented BigModel/Z.ai contract.

options.title: Require Overseas Host Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted `api.z.ai` GLM-5.2 run before merge if maintainers want host-specific proof beyond BigModel CN evidence.

options.title: Use Another Canonical Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR only if another linked PR lands first with equivalent two-builder coverage, type alignment, gated effort mapping, and real provider proof.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Contract
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after normal exact-head checks because both builders are aligned and the redacted live GLM-5.2 proof matches the documented BigModel/Z.ai contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent GLM-5.2 provider support, AI runtime extraction, and Z.ai reasoning review history make this the clearest owner route for provider-contract acceptance.
